title: Chiral 3d–4f Clusters with NIR-III Magneto-Optical Activity Driven by Lanthanide f–f Transition

synthesis.procedure: React Mn(ClO4)2, Ho(Ac)3, and enantiopure R-H3L2 in anhydrous ethanol, using triethylamine to regulate pH. The main article does not report reagent quantities or a complete preparation procedure.
synthesis.time: 2 hours stirring; crystals after one week
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter into a clean 25 mL beaker and seal with parafilm, leaving a small venting opening. Yellow-brown plate-like crystals form after one week.

properties.summary: The Ho-centered f–f transition gives pronounced NIR-III CD and field-induced MCD. Magnetic measurements indicate an overall weak antiferromagnetic tendency for the clusters.

measurements.name: maximum g_MCD
measurements.conditions: Ho3Mn4 series; 1600–2500 nm; MCD measured under a 1.6 T field

The three nearly collinear Ho centers have distorted tetragonal-antiprismatic coordination.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: R-enantiomer of the Ho12Mn12 cyclic cluster

synthesis.procedure: The cyclic cluster was obtained from the Ln3Mn4 reaction system by doubling the amount of triethylamine. The main article provides no starting quantity or complete procedure.

reagents.name: triethylamine
reagents.amount: double the amount used for the Ln3Mn4 reaction; absolute amount unreported

properties.summary: Pronounced Ho(III) f–f-derived NIR-III CD and MCD are reported. Its normalized MCD response is stronger than that of Ho3Mn4. Magnetic measurements indicate an overall weak antiferromagnetic tendency, with a calculated weak ferromagnetic Ho(III)–Mn(II) exchange component.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The R-Ho12Mn12 core is an approximately D4-symmetric ring assembled from four Ho3MnII2MnIII2 units sharing terminal Mn(II) ions. Its reported outer diameter is about 2.7 nm and its inner cavity about 1.7 nm. The nearly linear groups of Ho centers have distorted dodecahedral coordination.
